run_evals_head_to_head: run head-to-head agent evaluations across multiple seeds and powers with configurable variance reduction
get_power_scores_from_folder: load game scores for all powers from a directory of head-to-head game JSON and info files
get_power_scores_from_folder_with_json_p: load game scores with corresponding JSON file paths from a directory of head-to-head game files
launch_eval_tasks: launch SLurm or local tasks to run head-to-head games for missing power and seed combinations
get_default_output_dir: get the default output directory path for storing compare agents evaluation results by username
